reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getWorstCaseAmount/getExpectedAmount helpers and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every schedule-amount consumer picks it up.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; two one-line rule edits in the shared helpers plus comment and test updates.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines how a schedule amount is planned.

scope.why: Only the two rule lines, their comments and the corresponding tests change.

maintainability.why: Minimal, clearly commented change to a single definition; the helper name 'worst case' still matches the new meaning.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers (forecast, schedules app, schedule template, preview) already go through getExpectedAmount.
